headline: Revenue grows again as profitability and leverage worsen
summary_short: Revenue rose 17.4% y/y to $4,304M (down 9.1% q/q); net income of $216M fell 34.9% y/y even as it rebounded sharply off a weak prior quarter, while long-term debt climbed 75.3% y/y to $11,965M.
summary_long: Revenue was $4,304M, up 17.4% y/y but down 9.1% q/q. Gross profit of $1,837M rose 7.5% y/y yet fell 12.9% q/q; operating income of $79M dropped 64.6% y/y and 69.4% q/q, and EBIT of $401M fell 12.6% y/y though EBITDA of $817M rose 8.5% y/y. Net income of $216M fell 34.9% y/y despite rebounding from a depressed $23M prior quarter. EPS (diluted) of $1.23 fell 21.7% y/y from $1.57. Cash fell to $1,512M, down 1.6% y/y and 17.3% q/q, while long-term debt rose sharply to $11,965M, up 75.3% y/y.
